title: Two Plans for a Safer High Street
instructions: 这是为B1学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思试题，也不对应任何正式分数）。先读文章，再完成8道题。题目和选项均为英文；解释为中文。注意区分新学语法（比较级/最高级、方式与时间介词、how long/how often）与复习内容。
passage:
A. The town of Millbrook has one busy high street. Cars go fast, and many people want a safer road. Last month, the town council showed two plans. Plan A is called 'Slow Street'. Plan B is called 'Bus First'. People can read both plans online and send ideas before 30 June.

B. Plan A is cheaper than Plan B. It costs about £40,000. Workers will put three new zebra crossings near the school and the market. They will also build two small gardens with trees and benches. The speed limit will go down from 30 mph to 20 mph. Plan A is slower than Plan B for cars, but it is safer for children and older people. The council says the work will take six weeks. In Plan A, buses will stop at the same places as today.

C. Plan B is more expensive. It costs about £120,000. The council will move the bus stops to the middle of the high street and make one new bus lane. Buses will run every ten minutes, not every twenty minutes. The bus lane is the fastest way to travel in the morning. However, Plan B has fewer parking spaces than Plan A. Some shop owners are worried. They say, 'Our customers come by car. If parking is difficult, they will go to the big supermarket.'

D. The council will ask people how often they use the high street and how long they wait at crossings. The most popular plan will start in September. One council worker said, 'Both plans are good. Plan A is the cheapest, and Plan B is the quickest for buses. We want the best plan for everyone.'

questions.prompt: How much does Plan A cost?
questions.explanation: 文中B段明确说Plan A花费约£40,000。

questions.prompt: How long will the work take in Plan A?
questions.evidence: The council says the work will take six weeks.

questions.prompt: In Plan B, how often will buses run?
questions.explanation: C段说公交车每十分钟一班，而不是每二十分钟。
questions.evidence: Buses will run every ten minutes, not every twenty minutes.

questions.prompt: Which plan has fewer parking spaces?
options: Both plans have the same number
questions.explanation: C段说Plan B的停车位比Plan A少。
questions.evidence: However, Plan B has fewer parking spaces than Plan A.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The speed limit will go down from 30 mph to ____ mph.
questions.explanation: B段说限速从30 mph降到20 mph。
questions.evidence: The speed limit will go down from 30 mph to 20 mph.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The council will ask people how ____ they use the high street.
questions.explanation: D段说议会会问人们多常使用这条街。
questions.evidence: The council will ask people how often they use the high street

questions.prompt: Which heading best matches paragraph C?
options: Plan B: more expensive, faster buses
answers: Plan B: more expensive, faster buses
questions.explanation: C段主要讲Plan B更贵、公交更快、停车位更少。
questions.evidence: Plan B is more expensive. It costs about £120,000.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Plan A is the cheapest plan.
questions.explanation: D段明确说Plan A是最便宜的计划。
questions.evidence: Plan A is the cheapest, and Plan B is the quickest for buses.

grammar.title: 比较级、最高级、方式与时间介词、how long / how often
grammar.explanation: 先看意思：比较两个东西时，用“更……”的说法，如 cheaper（更便宜）、more expensive（更贵）；三个或更多里说“最……”，用 the cheapest（最便宜）、the most popular（最受欢迎）。短词常加 -er/-est，长词常用 more/most。表示“用某种方式/交通工具”用 by（by car, by bus）；表示具体时间点用 at（at 7 o'clock），表示某一天用 on（on Monday），表示月份/年份/较长时段用 in（in June, in September）。问“多长时间”用 how long（How long will the work take?）；问“多常/频率”用 how often（How often do you use the high street?）。注意：本课新学 how long / how often 与比较级/最高级；复习 by/at/on/in 的基本用法。
grammar.example: Plan A is cheaper than Plan B. / Plan B is the quickest for buses. / Buses will run every ten minutes. / The council will ask people how often they use the high street and how long they wait at crossings.

questions.prompt: This bag is ____ than that one.
questions.explanation: 有than，说明两者比较，用比较级cheaper。
questions.evidence: Plan A is cheaper than Plan B.

questions.prompt: This is the ____ shop in our town.
questions.explanation: 三者以上比较，且前面有the，用最高级the most popular。
questions.evidence: The most popular plan will start in September.

questions.prompt: I go to work ____ bus every day.

questions.evidence: The most popular plan will start in September.

questions.prompt: ____ does it take to walk to the station?
questions.explanation: 问所需时间长短用How long。
questions.evidence: The council will ask people how often they use the high street and how long they wait at crossings.

questions.prompt: ____ do you visit your grandparents? — Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 回答Twice a month是频率，问频率用How often。
questions.evidence: The council will ask people how often they use the high street
Plan A is cheaper than Plan B.
The most popular plan will start in September.
